## Last-checked: 2026-09-30

# ellmos-ai/ai-media-editor

Local-first AI media editor for video, audio, and podcast workflows. Part of the `open-bricks` ecosystem.

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ai-media-editor

## Summary

`ai-media-editor` prepares media projects for agent-driven editing. It routes local or remote
speech-to-text, writes the Scribe fields consumed by `video-use`, packs transcript/cut context,
generates timestamped frame views for visual judgment, and leaves the creative cut, animation,
and Hyperframes composition to an AI coding agent. The documented runtime invariants, dual-mermaid
diagrams, Level 1 SBOM, and 18-point navigation describe local-first defaults, unprivileged operation,
and reproducible audio/video artifacts.

## Audience

- AI agents that need a compact map of the repository before editing media.
- Developers building local-first podcast, video, and transcript-editing workflows.
- Creators who want transcript-based cuts without sending recordings to hosted STT.
- Tool builders comparing `video-use`, Hyperframes, faster-whisper, and WhisperX workflows.
- Organizations whose internal policies or contracts restrict sending recordings to hosted transcription providers.

- [Hindi overview](README_hi.md) — complete Hindi README with matching CLI examples, invariant IDs and explicit anchors.
- [Arabic overview](README_ar.md) — complete Arabic README with matching CLI examples, invariant IDs and explicit anchors.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — bilingual contribution guidelines, pre-commit quality gates, version freeze policy, and Plan D local dev setup.
- `CLAUDE.md` — German agent-facing workflow guide and hard editing rules.
- `docs/USECASES.md` — step-by-step instructions for the 8 supported media workflows.
- `editor.py` — orchestrator for `doctor`, `modes`, `prepare`, and `frames`.
- `stt/transcribe_local.py` — faster-whisper / WhisperX transcription path.
- `stt/diarize_llm.py` — token-free LLM-based speaker assignment.
- `tools/frame_view.py` — video frame sampling and contact-sheet context.
- `tools/cut_view.py` — pause-aware transcript cut candidates.
- `tools/make_loop.py`, `tools/qa_clips.py`, `tools/atmo.py`, `tools/synth.py`, `tools/fx.js` — multi-clip black-pause loop assembly, ffprobe/luma clip QA contact sheets, 48 kHz NumPy/SciPy procedural instrument & EBU R128 atmospheric synthesis, and deterministic seek-safe HyperFrames scene helpers (`HFX.ft` with `immediateRender: false`).
- `tools/hf.cmd`, `tools/hf-hidden.vbs`, `tools/hide-windows.cjs` — Windows wrapper + Node preload that forces `windowsHide` for every child process (no console-window bursts from HyperFrames); `tools/count_console_windows.ps1` measures visible windows. Details: `docs/WINDOWS-KONSOLENFENSTER.md`.
- `production/OVERVIEW.md` — optional generative workflows and mandatory cloud/rights gates.
- `NOTICE` — canonical open-source attribution and copyright notice for Lukas Geiger, ellmos-ai, and open-bricks.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` — Level 1 SBOM, inventory of third-party open-source components, and RunAsInvoker non-elevation certification.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` — Plain-text Level 1 SBOM companion listing recorded third-party license texts.
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt` — discoverability, 4 target personas, 10-dimension comparative matrix, and architecture audit log.
- `tests/test_core.py` — dependency-free regression contract for cache, remote, frames, and diarization.
- `tests/test_metadata.py` — automated contract tests for manifests, CI parity, security SLAs, 18-point navigation, and discoverability.
- `SECURITY.md` — bilingual vulnerability reporting and sensitive-media security scope (48h initial response SLA).
- `brand/design-tokens.css` — design tokens for generated motion graphics.

## Governance & Runtime Invariants (10 documented invariants)

- `INV-LOCAL-01`: Local-first by default; optional SSH STT transfers the input media file copy and any configured HF token; model loading is not forced offline.
- `INV-RUNAS-02`: Unprivileged Execution / RunAsInvoker Non-Elevation
- `INV-PREV-03`: Non-destructive input handling; `prepare` preserves the original and copies it into `projects/<name>/`. Temporary audio may use the OS temp directory; remote mode also uses the configured SSH work directory.
- `INV-DETERM-04`: Deterministic Waveform Synthesis & Scribe JSON Schemas
- `INV-BOUNDARY-05`: Lexical project-name checks; not a filesystem sandbox.
- `INV-SUBPROC-06`: Clean Subprocess Lifecycle & Windows Console Window Suppression
- `INV-PARITY-07`: Cross-platform support with operating-system-specific path configuration (Windows, Linux, macOS).
- `INV-SYNC-08`: Cloud-Sync & Multi-Agent Lock Concurrency Discipline
- `INV-DOCS-09`: Transparent Multimodal Accessibility & Bilingual Documentation
- `INV-SLA-10`: 48h Security Response & 5-Day Triage SLA

## Statutory Notice & Liability Limitation

This software is provided free of charge under the MIT License as open-source software.
Under German statutory law (§ 521 BGB - Gefälligkeitsrecht), liability in the case of
gratuitous provision of software is limited to intent (Vorsatz) and gross negligence
(grobe Fahrlässigkeit).

## Disambiguation

Not a hosted SaaS editor, generic ffmpeg GUI, stock-media marketplace, mobile video editor,
or ElevenLabs Scribe wrapper. This repository is an orchestration and agent-workflow layer
for local transcript, frame, and edit context.
